title: Shared naming convention tools v1
description: Reusable fragments, compositions, identifiers and version rules for any naming-convention domain.

$schema.title: Document schema URL
$schema.description: Optional URL identifying the schema of this naming-convention data document; distinct from the $schema dialect declaration in a JSON Schema definition.

StandardConventionsFile.title: Standard conventions file
StandardConventionsFile.description: Relative path to the file containing shared identifier and version convention definitions.

IdentifierConventions.title: Identifier conventions

Regexp.title: Regexp
Regexp.description: Regular expression defining the syntax recognized by this named convention.

ConversionStyle.title: Identifier conversion style
ConversionStyle.description: Optional lexical splitting and formatting policy. Custom regex conventions without a conversion style are validation-only. The style, not the naming convention ID, controls conversion.

additionalProperties.title: Additional Properties
additionalProperties.description: Definition of one named identifier convention.

IdentifierConventions.description: Named identifier conventions whose regular expressions validate or recognize identifiers.

VersionConventions.title: Version conventions

Regexp.title: Regexp
Regexp.description: Regular expression defining the syntax recognized by this named convention.

additionalProperties.title: Additional Properties
additionalProperties.description: Definition of one named version convention.

VersionConventions.description: Named version conventions whose regular expressions recognize version components.

Ref.title: Ref
Ref.description: Name of another defined fragment or composition to include at this position.

NameFragmentsSegmentReference.title: Reference segment
NameFragmentsSegmentReference.description: Segment referencing a previously defined named fragment or composition.

Kind.title: Kind
Kind.description: Determines how the segment value is interpreted during name construction.

oneOf.title: Constant string
oneOf.description: A literal text segment emitted without a lookup.

oneOf.title: Identifier
oneOf.description: A segment derived from an identifier, optionally using an identifier convention.

oneOf.title: Version
oneOf.description: A segment representing a version according to a version convention.

oneOf.title: Variable
oneOf.description: A segment resolved from a named variable in the generation context.

Value.title: Value
Value.description: Literal or resolved value emitted by the segment, according to its kind.

Convention.title: Convention
Convention.description: Required for identifier/version segments when a named identifier/version convention is selected; mutually exclusive with CustomConventionRegexp.

CustomConventionRegexp.title: Custom convention regexp
CustomConventionRegexp.description: Inline Java-style regular expression used instead of a named convention for an identifier/version segment. It must compile and provide the named capture group identifier or version respectively; checked by the naming catalog in Java/Python.

Name.title: Name
Name.description: Symbolic name of the variable or source value referenced by this segment.

Regexp.title: Regexp
Regexp.description: Regular expression defining the syntax recognized by this named convention.

NameFragmentsSegmentValue.title: Inline segment
NameFragmentsSegmentValue.description: One inline segment. Kind determines exactly which alternative fields are permitted: constant_string/Value, identifier or version/one of Convention and CustomConventionRegexp, variable/Name plus Regexp.

NameFragmentsSegmentChoice.title: Items
NameFragmentsSegmentChoice.description: One segment, expressed either as a reference or as an inline segment definition.

NameFragments.title: Name fragments

Segments.title: Segments
Segments.description: Ordered segments that make up this fragment or name composition.

additionalProperties.title: Additional Properties
additionalProperties.description: Definition of one named reusable name fragment.

NameFragments.description: Reusable named sequences of text, identifier, version or variable segments.

NameCompositions.title: Name compositions

Segments.title: Segments
Segments.description: Ordered segments using the same reference-or-value grammar as a name fragment.

additionalProperties.title: Additional Properties
additionalProperties.description: Definition of one named name composition.

NameCompositions.description: Named compositions that combine reusable fragments into full names.
